title: Marcker's General Electric experiment testing for spacetime torsion

tellings.quote: he did an experiment that was specifically designed to test whether torsion existed in space time and it was a wellth out apparatus very welld designed they did it at General Electric

plain: A scientist named Marcker is said to have run an experiment at General Electric to test whether torsion, a proposed twisting in the fabric of space and time, really exists. The researcher Eric W. Davis tells Michels about it without naming a source. He praises it as a well-thought-out, well-designed apparatus, which matters because a positive result would point to new physics.
